items.title: Meta Unveils Muse Wonder, Its First Frontier AI Model
items.summary: Meta has officially launched Muse Wonder, marking its entry into the frontier AI model space, signaling a significant advancement in its AI capabilities.

items.title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
items.summary: Researchers introduce S-Space, a novel approach to integrate and explore spatial workspace concepts within multimodal language models, enhancing their understanding of physical environments.

items.title: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
items.summary: SoftwareGym presents a new method for training AI agents to use computers more effectively by leveraging diverse synthesized software environments, addressing a key challenge in agentic AI.

items.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
items.summary: This paper investigates strategies for scaling agentic data to achieve long-horizon terminal intelligence, crucial for developing more autonomous and capable AI systems.

items.title: Honeyjar Offers AI Tools to Enhance PR and Communications for Businesses
items.summary: Honeyjar has launched new AI-powered tools designed to significantly improve public relations and communication strategies across various companies.

items.title: WindBorne Secures Major US Air Force Contract for Balloon Data Technology
items.summary: WindBorne has been awarded a substantial contract by the US Air Force for its innovative balloon-based data collection technology, highlighting its potential for defense applications.

items.title: GroundingPI: A Foundation Model for Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
items.summary: GroundingPI introduces a new grounding foundation model aimed at achieving physical intelligence by integrating visual primitives, enabling more robust interaction with the real world.

items.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
items.summary: This research evaluates the effectiveness of heuristic learning in AI agents within a long-running game competition, shedding light on their adaptive capabilities.

items.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
items.summary: Work2Skill proposes a method to capture human GUI experience, allowing for the induction of reusable skills in AI agents, making them more proficient in user interface interactions.

items.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
items.summary: AgentSWE explores the capability of coding agents to autonomously develop other agents, questioning the effectiveness and alignment of their generated solutions.

items.title: Contextual Correction of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding
items.summary: This paper introduces a technique for contextual correction of parallel drafts to improve the efficiency and accuracy of speculative decoding in language models.

items.title: Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models
items.summary: Researchers are benchmarking multimodal models on intuitive visual reasoning tasks, aiming to understand if they can replicate a 'sixth sense' for visual understanding.

items.title: Can a Local LLM Replace Claude Code? The Benchmark Everyone Quotes Is the Wrong One.
items.summary: This article challenges common benchmarks used to compare local LLMs against models like Claude Code, arguing for more relevant evaluation metrics.

items.title: Every 'No AI Contributions' Policy Is a Level 0 Control
items.summary: This piece argues that policies prohibiting AI contributions are rudimentary controls that fail to address the deeper implications and integration of AI in development.

items.title: I Have Four Controls for AI Agents. Each One Stops Measuring the Moment People Know It's There.
items.summary: An author discusses four control mechanisms for AI agents, noting that their effectiveness diminishes once human users become aware of their presence.
